player_prompt.intro:
Wɔyɛ Player {player_id} wɔ Chopsticks. Wɔ wo tɔɔ no, gye wo yɔnko biara:
  + Kyere:  '[attack M O]'  wɔ hɔ na M-yɛ wo nsa (0 anaa 1), O-yɛ ɔkɔmfo nsa (0 anaa 1).
    - ɔkɔmfo nsa mu akɔ soro na wo nsa; se ɛboro 5 a, ɛbɛyɛ 0.
  + Gye tom:   '[split L R]'  maa wo nsa no mu akɔ soro wɔ L ne R (L+R = wo nsa no mu akɔ soro).
Ka kɔmɛnt biara pɛ na fa bi.

invalid_move.split_sum: Ɛsɛ sɛ nea wɔkyekyɛ no yɛ {total}.
invalid_move.split_no_change: Ɛsɛ sɛ Split sesa wo nsa ano kyɛfa.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Tɔɔ bo. Fa ‘[attack M O]’ anaa ‘[split L R]’.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} kyere P{opp_id} nsa {opp_idx}: ɛsan afiri {opp_val} kɔ {new_val}.

outcome.win: Wɔn a wɔsɔre tia wɔn no nsa abien nyinaa awu.
